capabilities: Shows any note in a floating desktop window
Toggles the window with one global shortcut
Pins the window above other apps
Fades the window with an opacity slider
Finds and switches notes from the window
extras: Desktop only (mobile unsupported); relies on undocumented Electron APIs, so unavailable features disable with a notice; no network requests; settings saved in data.json.
problem: Obsidian notes stay inside the Obsidian window, so keeping a note visible while working in other apps means constant window switching.

relations.evidence: The unique-title native-window lookup follows the approach credited to Desktop Sticky Notes (MIT).
The remote entry-point fallback follows the approach credited to Quick Tray (MIT).

summary: Floating desktop window that shows any Obsidian note above other apps, with a global shortcut, pin, opacity and tray icon.
